verdict.rationale: Token2's official fido2-manage tool documents FIDO2 SSH security-key workflows: generating keys, listing resident keys, rehydrating them, uploading to remotes via ssh-copy-id, and adding them to ssh-agent. Separately, PIV is supported on the devices, so hardware-backed SSH via FIDO2 sk-ssh is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that server access requires a physical touch, evidence of SSH via PIV, any OpenPGP support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
